text_block_list.text: While many students were hard at work training, I spotted a lone student watching them from a distance.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um, everyone who's staying behind
is going to train together now, but...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: If you'd like, would you care to join me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No thanks. Go ask someone else.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yes... Thank you for having me.

She turned down the invitation with a curt brush-off,
but could there be some reason she can't run……?

After school that day, as I was getting ready to head home,
I caught sight of her running along the track.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hm...? What's up... Did you need something?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Then get lost. You're distracting me.
choice_data_list: You wanted to run alone, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian

You wanted to run alone, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Even without you telling me, I intend to keep things balanced.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Is that all you wanted to say? Because I'd like to get back to training.

With that curt reply,
Narita Brian took off running once more.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch... You watching? I can concentrate better alone...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So, would you mind letting me concentrate?

With those words, Narita Brian
dashed away.
